name: EvyaCreateStory
description: Draft a complete user story from project context and (on approval) push it to Azure DevOps + Teams.

name: EvyaCreateSubtask
description: Break a story into developer-ready subtasks. Requires StoryID.

name: EvyaStartDev
description: Kick off development — technical brainstorm (3+ approaches) then branch/PR/DoR gates, set ADO to In Progress.

name: EvyaFinishDev
description: Wrap development: AC coverage audit, diff check, Dev Summary, transition to Ready for QA.

name: EvyaStartQa
description: Generate comprehensive test plan and transition the story to In QA.

name: EvyaFinishQa
description: Validate QA pass, draft release notes, transition the story to Done.
